options.name: config_SGH
options.description: activate subglacial hydrology model

options.name: config_SGH_adaptive_timestep_fraction
options.description: fraction of adaptive CFL timestep to use

options.name: config_SGH_max_adaptive_timestep
options.description: The maximum allowable time step in seconds. If the allowable time step determined by the adaptive CFL calculation is longer than this, then the model will specify config_SGH_max_adaptive_timestep as the time step instead.  Defaults to 100 years (in seconds).

options.name: config_SGH_tangent_slope_calculation
options.description: Selection of the method for calculating the tangent component of slope at edges. 'from_vertex_barycentric' interpolates scalar values from cell centers to vertices using the barycentric interpolation routine in operators (mpas_cells_to_points_using_baryweights) and then calculates the slope between vertices.  It works for obtuse triangles, but will not work correctly across the edges of periodic meshes. 'from_vertex_barycentric_kiteareas' interpolates scalar values from cell centers to vertices using barycentric interpolation based on kiterea values and then calculates the slope between vertices.  It will work across the edges of periodic meshes, but will not work correctly for obtuse triangles. 'from_normal_slope' uses the vector operator mpas_tangential_vector_1d to calculate the tangent slopes from the normal slopes on the edges of the adjacent cells.  It will work for any mesh configuration, but is the least accurate method.

options.name: config_SGH_pressure_calc
options.description: Selection of the method for calculating water pressure. 'cavity' closes the hydrology equations by assuming cavities are always completely full. 'overburden' assumes water pressure is always equal to ice overburden pressure.

options.name: config_SGH_alpha
options.description: power of alpha parameter in subglacial water flux formula

options.name: config_SGH_beta
options.description: power of beta parameter in subglacial water flux formula

options.name: config_SGH_conduc_coeff
options.description: conductivity coefficient for subglacial water flux

options.name: config_SGH_till_drainage
options.description: background subglacial till drainage rate

options.name: config_SGH_advection
options.description: Advection method for SGH. 'fo'=first-order upwind; 'fct'=flux-corrected transport. FCT currently not enabled.

options.name: config_SGH_bed_roughness
options.description: cavitation coefficient

options.name: config_SGH_bed_roughness_max
options.description: bed roughness scale

options.name: config_SGH_creep_coefficient
options.description: creep closure coefficient

options.name: config_SGH_englacial_porosity
options.description: notional englacial porosity

options.name: config_SGH_till_max
options.description: maximum water thickness in subglacial till

options.name: config_SGH_chnl_active
options.description: activate channels in subglacial hydrology model

options.name: config_SGH_chnl_alpha
options.description: power of alpha parameter in subglacial water flux formula (in channels)

options.name: config_SGH_chnl_beta
options.description: power of beta parameter in subglacial water flux formula (in channels)

options.name: config_SGH_chnl_conduc_coeff
options.description: conductivity coefficient (in channels)

options.name: config_SGH_chnl_creep_coefficient
options.description: creep closure coefficient (in channels)

options.name: config_SGH_incipient_channel_width
options.description: width of sheet beneath/around channel that contributes to melt within the channel

options.name: config_SGH_include_pressure_melt
options.description: whether to include the pressure melt term in the rate of channel opening

options.name: config_SGH_shmip_forcing
options.description: calculate time-varying forcing specified by SHMIP experiments C or D

options.name: config_SGH_basal_melt
options.description: source for the basalMeltInput term.  'file' takes whatever field was input and performs no calculation.  'thermal' uses the groundedBasalMassBal field calculated by the thermal model.  'basal_heat' calculates a melt rate assuming the entirety of the basal heat flux (basalFrictionFlux+basalHeatFlux) goes to melting ice at the bed.  This is calculated in the SGH module and is independent of any calculations in the thermal model.
